test_item:
DebugAuth just logs an error, if verification or ID check failed.
(AuthData verification fails; the error is logged and the installed AuthData is retained)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. AuthData is already installed on the DUT
3. SAM dongle is inserted into the DUT
4. A USB drive containing an AuthData package with a mismatching signature is available
proc:
1. Record the content of /data/vendor/dauth on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth
2. Clear the log buffer before the verification attempt
$ adb logcat -c
3. Insert USB drive containing the invalid AuthData package into HU USB port
4. Confirm the logdog log after the previous step
$ adb logcat -s logdog
5. Record the content of /data/vendor/dauth on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth
er:
1. The adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth output lists the installed AuthData
2. The log buffer is cleared
3. <log keyword provided by RD (X-h)>
4. <log keyword provided by RD (X-h)>
5. The adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth output lists the same installed AuthData as in step 1
author: PeiPYHsu
